runs.text: Read 6 marks, from 0 to 10, and show how many are 6 or more. The program shows only the number.

hints.text: Where is the edge between passing and failing? On which side is 6?
Keep the marks and walk through them; for each one, a question.
A box counts the ones that meet it. If you do not need the position, you can walk through without an index.
and add 1 when the mark is 6 or more. Close with the variant.
